title: Trump Offered to Sell US Weapons to China at Xi Summit
detail: President Trump reportedly asked Xi Jinping during their bilateral summit whether China would like to purchase US weapons, while simultaneously downplaying American arms sales to Taiwan — according to the US Ambassador to Beijing. The extraordinary offer underscores the transactional nature of the Trump-Xi relationship and raises questions about the long-standing US commitment to Taiwan's defense.

media.caption: Trump and Xi Jinping at their summit where Trump raised the prospect of US weapons sales to China

title: Pakistani Pilots Begin Training for China's Tiangong Space Station
detail: Two Pakistani air force pilots have begun centrifuge and weightlessness training as Pakistan prepares to select its first astronaut for a mission to China's Tiangong space station. The milestone reflects the deepening China-Pakistan strategic partnership into the space domain and China's growing influence in shaping the next generation of non-Western space programs.

media.caption: Pakistani air force pilots undertaking weightlessness training ahead of a Tiangong space station mission
